title: General session small-tab open: attach error, Retry dead, then self-cleanup
body:
John 2026-07-28 (Anchor project window / general session):

Sometimes when I open a general session using the small tab it cannot find anything and comes back with an error. There is a Retry button, but that does not work. Then it cleaned itself up. Not sure why.

What happened:
- Opened a general session via the small tab (session-bar chip / compact general tile path).
- UI failed to attach a live terminal (could not find the session / no live PTY).
- Retry button did not recover.
- UI later cleaned itself up on its own.

Expected:
- Opening a general session from the small tab always attaches a live terminal when the session exists, or honestly offers resume/start when it does not.
- Retry must do real recovery (resume_live / warm reattach / start), not remount the same dead id.
- A failed attach must not silently vanish without a durable tile + summary so the session remains findable.

Cross-links: dual-terminal surfaces (docs/friction/2026-07-25-dual-terminal-screens.md); session stop/restart (friction 2026-07-28-02); attach-ack handshake in static/project-window.js _mountTerminal.

Success criteria for sleep:
1. Repro path: small-tab open of general when PTY missing / just-started / after service restart is documented and fixed.
2. attach_ack failure + Retry either recovers via resume_live (or clear restart) or surfaces a non-dead-end action (not remount-same-id only).
3. Stale MANAGED chip that cannot attach is not left as a fake-live tile; cleanup must leave a finished/warm tile with summary when the record still exists.
4. No silent disappearance of a session John just tried to open without board evidence of what happened.
